text:
phil: FYI ran into two small annoyances after upgrading redwoodctl via Homebrew on my M1 Mac: zsh autocompletion disappeared and my local profile seemed to vanish. anyone seen this?

zoe: what Homebrew path are you using? /opt/homebrew vs /usr/local makes a difference on arm64.

phil: /opt/homebrew. I did `brew upgrade redwoodctl` then `redwoodctl --version` shows v0.13.0 but when I open a new shell tab tab-complete for `redwoodctl` is gone. also `redwoodctl profiles list` returns empty even though `~/.redwood/config.yaml` still has my profile.

trent: likely two issues: 1) completion script got written to the wrong prefix (legacy `/usr/local/share/zsh/site-functions`) while your zsh fpath uses `/opt/homebrew/share/zsh/site-functions`. 2) the upgrade replaced the binary path and Homebrew sandboxed the config path for the new keg, so the runtime looked at `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/redwood` first.

phil: how do I fix completions quickly?

zoe: workaround: run `redwoodctl completion --shell zsh` which prints the completion script. Then save it to a directory on your fpath, e.g.:
```sh
mkdir -p /opt/homebrew/share/zsh/site-functions
redwoodctl completion --shell zsh > /opt/homebrew/share/zsh/site-functions/_redwoodctl
autoload -Uz compinit && compinit
```
That should restore tab-complete immediately.

phil: that worked, thanks. what about the missing profile though? config file is intact but CLI ignores it.

trent: check `echo $REDWOOD_CONFIG_PATH` and `echo $XDG_CONFIG_HOME`. Brew bottles sometimes set `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` to a sandboxed path in CI.

phil: `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` was set by my dotfiles to `~/.config` but the new binary tried `/Users/phil/Library/Application Support/redwood` and not `~/.redwood`. I guess path precedence changed in 0.13.0?

zoe: we changed lookup order to prefer platform-specific app dirs for macOS to support GUI apps. regression if users rely on legacy `~/.redwood`. Workaround: set `REDWOOD_CONFIG_PATH=~/.redwood/config.yaml` in your shell. Or run `redwoodctl profiles import --from ~/.redwood/config.yaml --set-current work`.

phil: import worked. maybe the upgrade should have migrated the user file automatically. filing a quick note.

trent: filed DX-620 to add a migration step and to install completions to both prefixes on macOS. Also adding a new command `redwoodctl completion install --shell zsh` to automate the placement. PR #2245 will include both fixes.

devex-bot: created issue DX-620: macos-homebrew-completion-config-migration and assigned to eng-devex.

phil: tiny UX nit: when `redwoodctl` ran with the new XDG path and found an empty config it printed `no profiles found` but didn't hint where it looked. took me a bit to debug.

zoe: good point. we'll add a diagnostic when `profiles list` is empty that prints the effective config path and env vars checked. adding to DX-620.

phil: last thing: after import my `local serve` hung once with `retrying auth token` logs. I had to `redwoodctl profiles rotate --profile work --token <token>` to fix. is there an auto-retry/backoff logic change?

trent: v0.13.0 introduced stricter token freshness checks; we added exponential backoff but also made the error messages clearer in the next patch. If you see persistent auth retries, rotate or re-login. We'll smooth the behavior in PR #2251.

release-bot: scheduled patch release redwoodctl v0.13.1 containing completion install, config migration, and better diagnostics (PRs #2245, #2251). ETA 47m.

phil: thanks all. i'll add the shell env `REDWOOD_CONFIG_PATH` to my dotfiles until v0.13.1 lands. saved the completion script too. :thumbsup:
